This article is about the city of [[Vurahi]] itself. for the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Municipality Municipality] [[Municipality of Vurahi|see Municipality of Vurahi]] 

'''Vurahi''' is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] of [[Areoix Lie]]. It is the country's oldest city and the seat of the Little House. '''Vurahi''' is the [[List of Arten cities by population|country's second-largest city by population]], after [[Zirohu]], and the largest city in the [[Virauza Premier|Virauza]] *Region*. The city is part of [[the City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality]]

The city is known for the [[Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], its natural setting in the [[Virauza Floristic Region]], and for landmarks such as [[Seat of Vurahi]] and [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens]]. Vurahi has been named the fith best city in the world for travelers, numerous times, including by ''[[The Tirna Times]]'' in 1760, ''[[Time in]]'' in 1764, and ''[[The Tele]]'' for the past 3 years (1762 through 1765).

Located on the banks of [[The Red River]], the City Bowl area of [[Vurahi]], which contains its [[central business district]] (CBD), is the oldest urban area in [[Virauza]], with a significant cultural heritage. The metropolitan area has Engulfed many surrounding towns and small cities such as; [[Kolba]], [[Zerali]], [[Havan]], [[Mandia]], ect, which are now suburbs as part of [[the City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality]]

[[Seat of Vurahi National Park]] is within the city boundaries and there are several other nature reserves within and adjacent to the city, protecting the diverse terrestrial natural environment. These include [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens]], which contains 5 of Arieox lies 8 biomes, and showcases many plants native to the Virauza region.

[[Vurahi]] has [[Areoix Lie|Areoix lies]] second highest household incomes, second lowest rate of unemployment, second highest level of infrastructure investment, second strongest service delivery performance, largest tourism appeal, and most robust real estate market.


== History ==
Main articles: [[History of Viruahi]] and [[Timeline of Vurahi|Timeline of Cape Town]]

=== Early period ===
The earliest known remnants of human occupation in the region were found at [[Peers Cave]] in [[Fish Bank]] and have been dated to between 60,000 and 55,000 years old. Archaeologists have found Neolithic settlements throughout the municipality, including , [[Havan Cave]] located in [[Havan]].  Evidence of stone tools, pottery, and stone weapons attest to about 10,000 years of human presence. Several excavations support the view that [[Vurahi]] grew from pastoral settlements<sup>[''better source needed'']</sup>

Nowadays, there is a wide consensus that the city developed gradually through the aggregation ("[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Synoecism synoecism]") of several villages around the largest one, placed above the [[Vurahi Imperial Palace|Imperial Palace]]. This aggregation was facilitated by the increase of agricultural productivity above the subsistence level, which also allowed the establishment of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Secondary_sector_of_the_economy secondary] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tertiary_sector_of_the_economy tertiary activities]. These, in turn, boosted the development of trade with the local tribes (mainly [[The Choan Ti Tribe|Choan Ti]] and [[The Cumae Tribe|Cumae]]). These developments, which according to archaeological evidence took place during the twenty seventh-twenty ninth century BFA, can be considered as the "birth" of the city. Despite recent excavations at the [[Vurahi Imperial Palace]], the view that [[Vurahi]] was founded deliberately in the middle of the twenty seventh century BC, as the [[legend of Vurahin]] suggests, remains a fringe hypothesis

==== Legend of the founding of Vurahi ====
Main articles: [[Legend of Vurahin]]

Traditional stories handed down by the ancient Vury themselves explain the earliest history of their city in terms of legend and myth. The most familiar of these myths, and perhaps the most famous of all Arten myths, is the ,  [[legend of Vurahin]] the Ancient [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/King king] Who was told by the gods to Found an [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire empire] . [[Vurahin]] decided to build a city, but after an argument, [[Vurahin]] killed his Brother and the city took his name. According to the Arten annalists, this happened on 21 4th 2742 BFA. This legend had to be reconciled with a dual tradition, set earlier in time, that had the [[Mepqo]] refugee [[Aeneas]] escape up [[the blue river]] and found the line of Artens through his son Iulus, the namesake of the [[Vera-Claudian]] dynasty. This was accomplished by the Arten poet [[Virgil]] in the tenth century BC. In addition, [[Hellios The thinker]] mentions an older story, that the city was an [[Mepqo]] colony founded by [[Evander]]. [[Hellios The thinker]] also writes that [[Coelius Antipater]] believed that [[Vurahi]] was founded by [[Mepqo]].

=== Monarchy ===
Main articles: [[Ancient Vurahi]] and [[kingdom of Areoix Lie]]

After the foundation by [[Vurahin]] according to a legend, [[Vurahi]] was ruled for a period of 350 years by a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Monarchy monarchical system], initially with sovereigns of Arten later by Mepqo Kings. The tradition handed down seven kings: [[Vurahin]], [[Numa]], [[Tullarzian]], [[Ancuzelam]], [[Tarquinius]], [[KIng Vera|Vera]] and [[Mepqovian The last]]. not much is known about this era exept for the written accounts of [[Piranes]].

=== 1st Empire ===
Main article: [[Empire of Areoix Lie|1st Empire of Areoix Lie]] 

In 2398 BFA , [[Vera the great|Vurian]] was named [[Vera the Great]], founding the [[Empire of Areoix Lie|Empire of Areiox Lie]], a complete and total empire controlled from [[Vurahi]]. Over time, the new monarch came to be known as the ''Imperium'' (hence [[Areoix Lie Emperor|emperor]]), meaning "commander". In 683 BFA the city is estimated to have reached 100,000 inhabitants. During the reign of [[Nurem]], two thirds of the city was ruined after the [[Great Fire of Vurahi]], and the persecution of ________ commenced. Vurahi would be conquered and [[First Sacking of Vurahi|sacked]] by the [[Kitrum Sei]] in the sixth century BFA But would be conquered back after 68 years. Vurahi Would fall and be [[Second Sacking of Vurahi|sacked again]] in 480 BFA by the [[Ukardari Empire]]. [[Vurahi]] become Capital of the [[Asturian Empire]] After the [[Ukardari Miltary Revolt]] in 345 BFA. [[Vurahi]] Would be Restored to [[Areoix Lie]] and made [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital Capital] Again after the [[Arten War of Independence]] led by [[Emperor Thrawn]]. Until its conquest by the [[Ukardari Empire|Ukardari]] the empire was ruled by emperors of the [[Claudian]], [[Flavian]] (who built an [[first Imperial Palace of Vurahi]] ), and [[Hinete]] dynasties.

=== Cratavian Empire ===
Main article: [[Cratavian Empire]]

In 87 BFA After the [[Cratvian Civil War|Cratavian Civil War]] and the [[Cratavian siege of Vurahi]] the  [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital Capital] was moved to [[Rukiva]]. The [[Cratavian Empire]] Would Militarize heavily which Transformed and heavily fortified [[Vurahi]]<nowiki/>s infrastructure. Parts of this can still be seen in the ancient grid system introduced as well as in many ancient sites such as; [[Cratavian City walls]], [[The temple of Vrag ruins]] and [[1st Citadel ruins of Vurahi|the 1st Citadel ruins]].  (Fall of andah insert) [[The Bugher revolt of Vurahi|The Bugher revolt]] of 23 AFA and its Harsh Backlash would Destroy much of the Cities trading abilities until their construction 40 years later. This period of time marked a steep Decline for the city known as [[The Vurahi Dark Age]]. This period was marked by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Starvation mass starvation], [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Plague plague], and destruction of monuments including the [[1st Imperial palace of Vurahi|1st Imperial palace]]. The decline of the city's population was caused by the loss of grain shipments from [[Zerania]], from 45 AFA onward, and the unwillingness of the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Burgher_(social_class) Bugher class] to maintain donations to support a population that was too large for the resources available. Even so, strenuous efforts were made to maintain the monumental centre, the Monumental damage to the city is often under exaggerated, and the largest baths, would not function until the [[Almaglean]] take over. The large baths of [[Varana]] on the [[Quirinale]] weren't even repaired until [[Almaglean]] take over almost 200 years later

The city wouldn't reach its previous level of prestige until the [[Almaglean]] rule

=== Almaglean rule ===
Main article: [[Almaglean|Almaglean Empire]]

In 193 BFA The [[Ancient city of Vurahi|ancient Capital]] would be conquered and restored to its former glory as [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] by the [[Almaglean Tribes]] from the north founding their [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Empire empire] in this historical city. This era would mark the [[Vurahi golden age]] which would lead to the restoration of the city and construction of the [[Second Imperial Palace of Vurahi|second Imperial Palace]]. This period would see the establishment of the first [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suburb suburbs] of [[Vurahi]]. The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stability stability] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prosperity prosperity] from this era would create many great [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sculpture sculptors] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Artist artists] such as; [[Virian]], [[Kolang]], [[Michalen]], [[Rozan]] and many others. The cities first [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens]] were established. One of the long lasting affects of the [[Almaglean|Almaglean Empire]] was the [[Firvan system]] or in other terms the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inheritance heir] to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Throne throne] would manage the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] almost like a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayor mayor] would today. The [[Vurahi golden age]] would come to an abrupt end during the [[Almaglean plague]] in 519 AFA. Shortly after this the [[Arten Uprising]] would begin. The city would remain under [[Almaglean|Almaglen control]] until 522 AFA after the end of the [[Arten Uprising]]. the City was handed over peacefully.

=== 2nd Empire ===
Main article: [[2nd Areoix Lie Empire|2nd Empire of Areoix Lie]] 

In 522 AFA The [[2nd Areoix Lie Empire|2nd Empire of Areoix Lie]] after the end of the [[Arten Uprising]] The city would Remain untouched by the war however the [[Almaglean plague]] had left the city empty and deserted. It is estimated a only a 150,000 of the cities 500,000 survived the plague. [[House Un Lie]] would become extremely powerful in and around the city during this era.The population is only believed to have recovered in the late 630s AFA. The [[Firvan system]] would be reintroduced a year after the [[Arten Uprising]] which would remain unchanged until the [[Declaration of Rights]]. In 587 AFA the town of [[Havan]] was raided and sacked by the [[Rauh tribe]]. The Tribe was [[The Rauh Massacre|mascaraed]] shortly after and its lands repopulated. [[The Mad Emperor Gion]] would [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Massacre massacre] all groups he believed to not be pure [[Arten]] all within the walls of [[Vurahi]]. The [[Imperial Aten Border War]] in 648 AFA would lead to a mass [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exodus exodus] of young men and their families into the [[Arten Frontier]]. This would invoke a period of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Stagnation stagnation] within the city for the city for the next 50 years. ( insert great church construction and completion here ). [[The 3rd Arten-Grasis War|The 3rd Arten-Grasis war]] would result in a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Exodus exodus] of young men as the [[Imperial Aten Border War]] 100 years later. In 803 AFA the [[Terresin district]] was established and would only continue to grow year after year. Traveler [[Je Moy]] from [[Dahe]] would pass through [[Vurahi]] in 876 AFA. His writings tell us a unbiased report of the city during this era. The most impressive thing from his writings is the state of [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens]].  

=== War of the Five Thrones ===
Main article: [[War of five thrones]] 

[[Emperor Zerzies]] died heirless In 925 AFA, the result of this was the Empire shattering between the [[5 great houses]]; [[House Un Lie]], [[House Cin Lie]], [[House Trei Lie]], [[House Heiso]], and the [[New Kingdom of Asnaria]], Each House fighting for the ultimate goal. That being Restoring [[Areoix Lie]] under their [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Ruling_class rule]. [[Vurahi]] Would be under the control of [[House Un Lie]] at the start of the war. The City would be [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conscription#M levied] and soon after be the [[1st Siege of Vurahi]] would begin In  928 AFA after [[House Cin Lie]] crossed [[the blue river]]. The citys fate was locked after the besieging armys Navy was destroyed in the [[Battle of Vurahi]] and Un Lie naval dominance was secured. After 6 years of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Siege siege] the invading army of [[Terresin]] from the south would reach [[Vurahi]] while at the same time the [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] Relief force arrived and they met in [[The Battle of the 3 kingdoms]]. The result was a catastrophic [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] victory. [[House Cin Lie]] was destroyed and every last heir [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital_punishment executed] exept for [[Lord Viner Un Lie]] who fled to [[Moonaa]]. House Un Lie would proceed to dominate and vassalize its rivals and in 943 AFA The [[Treaty of the one throne]] was signed bringing and end to a 18 year long war. The country as whole was decimated and depopulated. [[Vurahi]] was not except from the carnage. The [[1st Siege of Vurahi|siege]] had laid waste to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Rural_area country side] and Migrants flocked to [[Vurahi|the Imperial City]].

=== 3rd Empire ===
Main article:  [[3rd Empire of Areoix Lie]]

[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Symbol Symbols] and icons of the old [[Tavhiru Dynasty]] would be torn down and replaced with new [[House Un Lie|Un Lie]] symbols. These can still be seen on the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], which was torn down and rebuilt after the war. In the late 10thcentury, [[Emperor Vera Zerva Plato|Emperor Vera Plato]] extended the [[Imperial fortress of Vurahi|Imperial fortress]] to defend the city against river invasions from the west, gave [[Vurahi]] its first walls between 990 and 1015, rebuilt its bridges to either side of its central island, and paved its main thoroughfares. In 990, he transformed [[Vurahi|Vurahi's]] former cathedral school into a student-teacher corporation that would become the [[University of Vurahi]] and would draw students from all of [[Acrohea]].

In 1087 AFA the [[Kaastinial Invasion of Areoix Lie|Kaastinial Invasions]] would reach [[Vurahi]]. They would unsuccessfully try to [[2nd Siege of Vurahi|siege and storm Vurahi]]. The Siege is notable for the Death of [[Emperor Vera I]] While leading the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Charge_(warfare) Cavalry Charge] which broke the siege. After 3 years of war the Invading Armies of the [[Kaastinial Empire]] would be pushed back into [[Ayuman]]. 

In the 12th century the institutions of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Central_government central government], which had hitherto followed the Imperial Degrees around the country, grew in size and sophistication and became increasingly fixed, for most purposes at The [[3rdImperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], although the Imperial treasury came to rest in the [[Imperial Fortress]]. While the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]] developed into a true governmental capital, [[Vurahi]], remained [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lie's]] largest city and principal commercial Centre and flourished under its own unique administration, the [[Corporation of Vurahi]]. In

During the 14th century, Cardinal Varanemur, chief minister of [[Emperor Vera IX|Vera IX]], was determined to make [[Vurahi]] the most beautiful city in [[Acrohea]]. He built five new bridges, a new chapel for the [[College of Rovavga ( Vurahi|College of Rovavga]], and a palace for himself, the [[Palace of the Emperor|Palace-Cardinal]]. === Post Empire Era ===
Main article:  [[Arten Revoloution]] [[Modern Areoix Lie]]

In the summer of 1715, [[Vurahi]] became the centre stage of the [[Arten Revolution]]. On 14th, a mob seized the arsenal at the [[Varugian]], acquiring thousands of guns, with which it [[Storming of the Imperial Fortress|stormed the Imperial Fortess]], a principal symbol of Imperial authority. The first independent [[Vurahi]] city council, met in the ''[[Pevian Hall]]'' and elected a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mayor Mayor], the [[General Sylvain Vera Bailly]], on 15 12th.

Vera IX and the Imperial family were [[The Womens March on the Imperial Palace|brought to Vurahi square]] and incarcerated in the cells of the [[Imperial Fortress of Vurahi|Imperial Fortress]]. In 1716, as the revolution turned increasingly radical, known today as the [[Arten Revoloution|Arten Revoloution.]] The Emperor, Empress and Heir were beheaded by [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guillotine guillotine] in the [[Reign of Terror]], along with more than 134,000 others throughout [[Areoix Lie]]. The property of the aristocracy and the church was [[The Great Reset of Areiox LIe|nationalized]], and the city's churches were closed, sold or demolished. A succession of revolutionary factions ruled [[Vurahi]] until 9 11th 1716 , up too the ( [[Coup of the Nation]] ) [[Orin Valorion|Orin Valorum]] seized power as First Consul and later as [[Presidents of Areoix|president]].

The population of [[Vurahi]] had dropped by 1,000,000 during the Revolution, but after 1719 it surged with 1,560,000 new residents, reaching 15,000,000 by 1725. [[Orin Valorion|Valorum]] replaced the elected government of [[Vurahi]] with a prefect that reported directly to him. He began erecting monuments to Cutural glory, including the [[Arc fa Areiox Lie]] and improved the neglected infrastructure of the city with new fountains, the [[Canal fe Liriath]], [[Père Fachaise Industries]] and the city's Second Airport, [[Valorian International]]. Over [[Orin Valorion|Valorums]] 5 terms he would Gradually introduce Democratic Liberties.  The [[Mayor of Vurahi]] was established in 1718. It was the Elected position in [[Areoix Lie]] to serve a full term. The [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]] was transformed into the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|presidential palace]] and in 1721 [[The Areoix Lie House of Parliament|The House of Parliament]] finished construction

The scars of The Imperial governments Zoning can still be seen to this day. The divide between poor neighborhoods and Wealthy ones is as little as a wall in areas. The [[Central Business district of vurahi|Central Business district]] (CBD) has a homeless epidemic. The suburb of [[Vor handa]] was transformed into a massive public housing bloc, the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Suburb suburb] is infamous for being the Centre of the [[The Drug epidemic In Areoix Lie|drug epidemic]] within [[Areoix Lie]]. [[Vurahi]] has undergone significant changes in the years since [[3rd Empire of Areoix Lie|The Empire]]. [[Vurahi|IT]] has experienced economic growth and development in the post-Empire era. The HDI index steadily rose until 1735 shortly after [[Assassination of Orin Valorum|Valorum was assassinated]]. The [[RPAL Party|RPAL party]] became notorious for rampant [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Corruption corruption] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/State_capture state capture] on all levels on goverment. 

[[DAEL|The DAEL]], a liberal political party came to power in [[Vurahi]] in 1737, has been credited with improving bureaucratic efficiency, public safety and fostering economic development.  The city has become a major economic hub in [[Areoix Lie]], attracting international investment and tourism in recent years. In 1738 the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Presidential palace]] was dismantled and transformed into the [[Imperial Museum of Areoix Lie|Imperial Museum]]

In 1748, [[President Dan Sarkozy]] launched the [[The City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality|Grand Vurahi project]], to integrate [[Vurahi]] more closely with the towns in the region around it. After many modifications, the new area, named the [[the City Vurahi Metropolitan Municipality]] with a population of 19.8 million, was created on 1 1st 1750. In 1751, the [[Vurahi|City of Vurahi]] and the national government approved the plans for the [[Grand Vurahi Express|Grand Vurahi Express,]] totalling 890km (553.02 mi) of automated metro lines to connect [[Vurahi]], the innermost three Municipalities around [[Vurahi]], airports and [[high-speed rail (TGV)]] stations, at an estimated cost of 35 billion. The system is scheduled to be complete in 1770 however the majority of it is already operational and is held with a high public opinion.

In 1st 1755, [[Fa-Baravon]] in the [[Terressin]] claimed attacks across the [[Vurahi]] region. [[The March against Terror ( Vurahi )|5.5 million people marched in Vurahi]] in a show of solidarity against terrorism and in support of freedom of speech. In November of the same year, terrorist attacks, claimed by IDEM killed 260 people and injured more than 1350

Nowadays [[Vurahi]] is led by [[Vera Namqic|Mayor Vera Namqic]]. The DAEL won 37 of the cities 52 seats in the last election.

=== Climate ===
The climate of the city of [[Vurahi]], and that of most of the province, is [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Humid_subtropical_climate humid subtropical] (''Cwa'', according to the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K%C3%B6ppen_climate_classification Köppen climate classification]), moderated by the Pampas winds, cold winds that blow from the north-western quadrant, which originate from the mountains.
[[Vurahi]] has a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mediterranean_climate#Hot-summer_Mediterranean_climate hot-summer Mediterranean climate] ([https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/K%C3%B6ppen_climate_classification Köppen climate classification] ''Csa'') with a strong continental influence, shifting from relatively cool and wet in the winter to dry and hot days in the summer months between June and September. Rainfall can reach up to 800 mm (31 in) in good years. The winter highs typically reach around 15 °C (59 °F) and winter lows average about 2.5 °C (35 °F) in December–January. Frost is common during the winter period. The summer highs peak in July and August at approximately 34.5 °C (94 °F) with average lows of 18 °C (64 °F). The highest and lowest temperatures ever recorded in the city are 46.7 °C (116 °F) and −8.2 °C (17 °F), respectively. Snowfall on average occurs once every 3 years. [[Vurahi]] recorded snowfall in three straight years in 1756,1757 and 1758.

=== flora and fauna ===
Main article: [[Biodiversity of Vurahi]]

Located in a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Conservation_International Conservation International] [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Biodiversity_hotspot biodiversity hotspot] as well as the unique [[Virauza Floristic Region]], the [[Vurahi|city of Vurahi]] has one of the highest levels of biodiversity of any equivalent area in the world.

These protected areas are a World Heritage Site, and an estimated 2,200 species of plants are confined to the [[Seat of Vurahi]] – more than exist in the whole of [[Emara]] which has 1200 plant species and 67 endemic plant species. Many of these species, including a great many types of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Protea proteas], are endemic to the mountain and can be found nowhere else.

It is home to a total of 19 [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Phytochorion different vegetation] types, of which several are endemic to the city and occur nowhere else in the world. It is also the only habitat of hundreds of endemic species, and hundreds of others which are severely restricted or threatened. This enormous species diversity is mainly because the city is uniquely located at the convergence point of several different soil types and micro-climates.

The [[Seat of Vurahi]] has an unusually rich biodiversity. Its vegetation consists predominantly of several different types of the unique and rich Vurahi [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Fynbos Fynbos]. The main vegetation type is endangered Vurahi Sandstone Fynbos, but critically endangered Vurahi Granite Fynbos, Vurahi Shale Renosterveld and Afromontane forest occur in smaller portions on the mountain.

Rapid population growth and urban sprawl has covered much of these ecosystems with development. Consequently, [[Vurahi]] has over 300 threatened plant species and 13 which are now extinct. [[The Virauza plain]] has the highest concentration of threatened species of any continental area of equivalent size in the world.

Tiny remnant populations of critically endangered or near extinct plants sometimes survive on road sides, pavements and sports fields. The remaining ecosystems are partially protected through a system of over 30 nature reserves – including the massive [[seat of vurahi National Park]].

A worldwide survey suggested that the extinction rate of endemic plants from [[Vurahi]] is one of the highest in the world, at roughly three per year since 1700 – partly a consequence of the very small and localized habitats and high endemicity

== Government ==


Main article:  [[the City of Vurahi]] .  
{{Politics of Viruauzau|list1title=Constitution|list1=[[List of acts of the Virauzua Provincial Parliament]]|list2title=Executive|list2=[[Premier]] <br> The Hon [[Auren Feyvax]] [[MPP]] <br> Provincial Cabinet|list3title=Provincial Parliament|list3=[[Virauzau Parliment]] <br> The Ninth Provincial Parliament <br> Speaker <br>  [[Dan Plato]] <br> Deputy Speaker <br>[[ Mrya Walker]] <br> Political parties|list4title=Judiciary|list4=[[Virauzau Division of the high court of Areoix LIe]]|list5title=Administrative divisions|list5=[[ list of municipalities Virauzau]]|list6title=Elections|list7title=Related topics|list8title=Other provinces|list6=1718, 1723, 1728, 1733, 1738, 1743, 1748, 1753, 1758, 1763|list7=[[ Anti Xenophobia March of Vurahi]]|list8=TBC}}
[[Vurahi]] is governed by a 506-member city council elected in a system of mixed-member proportional representation. The city is divided into 253 wards, each of which elects a councillor by first-past-the-post voting. The remaining 253 councillors are elected from party lists so that the total number of councillors for each party is proportional to the number of votes received by that party.

In the 1763 Municipal Elections, the [[DAEL]] kept its majority, this time diminished, taking 402 seats. [[RPAL Party|RPLA]] lost substantially, receiving 21 of the seats. [[DAEL]] candidate for the [[Vurahi]] mayoralty, [[Vera Namqic]] was elected mayor.

In recent years, [[Vurahi]] has developed a reputation for good governance, with the city's infrastructure spending and upkeep, political stability, CBD safety, and municipal service delivery being generally regarded as the second best out of all the major metropolitan areas in [[Areoix Lie]]. In 1765, [[Vurahi]] was, for the fourteenth year in a row, the longest standing metropolitan municipality in [[Areoix Lie]] to receive a clean audit outcome from its Auditor General (AG), [[Takani Maleke]].

According to the AG, municipalities that achieve clean audits display strong financial and performance management, whilst adhering to legislative requirements, and [[Vurahi]] is a model of governance and accountability. The AG further stated that [[Vurahi]] showed strong leadership, skilled personnel, accurate records, credible reporting to communities, and good quality planning and performance management. The city has maintained its clean audit status since 1751

According to the [[Areoix Lie National Census of 1764|Areoix Lie National Census of 1764,]] the population of the [[The City of Vurahi|City of Vurahi metropolitan municipality]] – an area that includes suburbs and exurbs – is 21,581,000 people. This represents an annual growth rate of 0.51% compared to the results of the previous census in 1754 which found a population of 20519894 people. 

Of those residents who were asked about their first language, 84.7% spoke [[Arten]] , 5.5% spoke [[Asnarian]] and 4.9% spoke [[Terris]] 5.9% spoke other. 10.4% of the population is under the age of 15, while 8.5% is 65 or older. The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Human_sex_ratio sex ratio] is 0.96, meaning that there are slightly more women than men.

Of those residents aged 20 or older, 0.2 % have no schooling, 1.1% have some schooling but did not finish primary school, 2.6% finished primary school but have no secondary schooling, 2.9% have some secondary schooling but did not finish [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Twelfth_grade Grade 12], 39.9% finished Grade 12 but have no higher education, and 36.7% have higher education.

Overall, 76.6% have at least a Grade 12 education. Of those aged between 5 and 25, 87.8% are attending an educational institution. Amongst those aged between 15 and 65 the unemployment rate is 5.7%.

The average annual household income in the [[Virauzau]], of which [[Vurahi]] is the [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Capital capital] and largest city, is [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lies]] second highest, by a large margin. As of June 1765, the province's average household income is ₳60,000 (AAR). This amount is 15% higher than third-place [[Alvantia]], and 30% above the national average.

The total number of households grew from 5,839,033 in 1744 to 8,068,572 in 1764, which represents an increase of 63.6%. The average number of household members declined from 3.92 in 1996 to 3,50 in 1764. Of those households, 98.4% are in formal structures (houses or [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartment flats]), while 1.6% are in informal structures (shacks).

99.8% of City-supplied households have access to [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Mains_electricity electricity], and 99.6% of households use electricity for lighting. 98.5% of households have [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Water_supply piped water] to the dwelling, while 12.0% have piped water through a communal tap. 94.9% of households have regular [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Waste_collection refuse collection service].

91.4% of households have a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Flush_toilet flush toilet] or [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Chemical_toilet chemical toilet], while 4.5% still use a bucket toilet. 92.1% of households have a [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Refrigerator refrigerator], 96.3% have a television and 98.1% have a radio. Only 70% have a landline telephone, but 95.1% have a cellphone. 87.9% have a computer, and 97.3% have access to the Internet (either through a computer or a cellphone).

In 1754 over 70% of cross provincial [[Arten]] migrants coming into the [[Virauzau]] settled in [[Vurahi]]; 43.64% of [[Arten]] migrants into the [[Virauzau]] came from [[The Peranau]] , and 15.95% came from [[Alvantia]] province.

[[Vurahi]] has a young population. In the 1764 census, the median age of residents in the city was 37. In the same year, approximately 30% of the population of Vurahi was under the age of 25.

The [[Virauzau]] province, in which [[Vurahi]]  is the largest city, has the highest rate of marriage out of all Arten provinces, by a significant margin. In the 1764 census, 63.8% of those in the province were legally married – almost 5% higher than the next province. In the same census, 20.6% of Virauzau residents had never been married – the lowest out of all Arten provinces.

In 1764, the city expected its population to grow by an additional 400,000 residents between 1760 and 1764, with 76% of those new residents falling into the low-income bracket, earning less than ₳1,200 a month.

According to the United Nations' World Urbanization Prospects (1758), Vurahi's population is projected to continue growing steadily over the next decade. Based on estimates compiled by the Department of Economic and Social Affairs in 1759 , the city's population is expected to reach approximately 23,300,000 million by 1774 , and roughly 25,000,000 million by 1790.

=== Religion ===
See also: [[Religion in Areoix Lie]]

(undisclosed as of now)

=== Crime ===
In recent years, [[Vurahi]]  has experienced Diminishing violent crime, particularly driven by gang crack down in areas like [[Vor Handa]]. This decrease in violence is attributed to various factors including diminishing economic inequality (which can be linked to the legacy of Empires spatial and social divisions), diminishing [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Unemployment unemployment rates], lower rates of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Alcohol_abuse alcohol abuse], the crack down of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Firearms illegal firearms], a increase of rehabilitation and support services for offenders leading to less [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Recidivism recidivism], and a build up of community safety organizations.

As with other major metropolitan areas in [[Areoix Lie]], the majority of crime in Vurahi tends to be concentrated in very specific areas, indicating the potential success of place-based crime intelligence methods. In Vurahi, a lot of the crime that occurs takes place in the neighborhoods of [[Vor Handa]], [[Delft]], [[Nanga]], [[Muveni]], [[Chevelia]], [[Elsies River]], [[Bishop Lavis]], [[Veroka]], and [[Myras Plain]], which are best avoided (even during transit) by tourists and locals alike

In early 1765, the [[City of Vurahi]] announced that progress had been made in combatting crime, with crime levels in certain notorious areas decreasing , according to statistics based on community reporting of incidents of crime. Daily patrol officers were complimented for their efforts, and the City said it was working closely with [[the Virauzau Government]] and the [[Arten Police Service]] to adjust its law enforcement efforts according to changes in the city's crime statistics

Despite the crime levels, the city's [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Economy economy] has grown, as a result of good governance, investments in infrastructure, and an attractive business environment, as well as due to growth in the local [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourism tourism] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Real_estate real estate] industries. Since July 1759 violent crime in certain poorer gang present areas of greater Vurahi has resulted in an ongoing military presence in these neighbourhoods.

In 1760, Vurahis Mayoral Committee Member (MCM) for Safety and Security, [[JP Plato]] said that the expanded use of digital tools to complement law enforcement efforts has become part of the city's public safety operations. These tools include a vast network of CCTV cameras and drones, which have already proven successful in assisting with both arrests and prosecution.

== Economy ==
See also: [[Economy of Virauzau]]

[[Vurahi]] is [[Areoix Lie|Areoix Lies]] second biggest economic center, only behind [[Zirohu]] in terms of annual economic output, despite having a considerably smaller population than [[Zirohu]]. The city is also [[Acrohea]]'s third-largest economic hub. It serves as the regional financial and manufacturing center in the [[Virauzau]] province.

The city has a diverse economy that is not significantly reliant on any particular sector. While the financial sector accounts for 22% of the Virauzau's annual economic output, as of 1765, its tech sector is growing at an annual rate of 17%. The city also has a substantial Green Economy, with around ₳15 billion invested into the sector in 2024 alone.

=== Income levels ===
As of June 1765, [[Vurahi]] has [[Areoix Lie]] second highest average household income , as well as the country's second lowest rate of unemployment, and strongest-performing property market.

The average annual household income in the [[Virauzau]] is the highest in [[Areoix Lie]], by a significant margin. As of June 1765, the province's average household income is ₳92,000 This amount is 15% higher than third-place [[Alvantia]], and 30% above the national average.

=== Employment levels ===
unemployment has been on a constant decreasing trend nation wide in all major cities across the country in recent years, [[Vurahi]]  is no exception. In 1765, it was reported that the city had added 186,000 jobs. [[Mayor of Vurahi|The Mayor of Vurahi]] attributed this growth to good governance and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Infrastructure infrastructure investments], creating an attractive [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Business business] environment and an increase in [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tourism tourism].

The Virauzau's unemployment levels are well below the national average. Formal sector jobs in the Virauzau grew by 3.1% in 1764- 61% higher than the national average.

=== Economic output ===
In 1760, the city's [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gross_metropolitan_product GMP] of {{lahn}}654 billion represented 71.1% of the [[Virauzau|Virauzau's]] total [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gross_regional_domestic_product GRP] and 9.6% of [[Areoix Lie]] total GDP; the city also accounted for 11.1% of all employed people in the country and had a citywide [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/GDP_per_capita GDP per capita] of {{lahn}}43,764.

Since the Great Recession, the city's economic growth rate has mirrored [[Areoix Lie]] line in growth; the population growth rate for the city has remained steady at around 1% a year. Around 80% of the city's economic activity is generated by the tertiary sector of the economy with the finance, retail, real-estate, food and beverage industries being the four largest contributors to the city's economic growth rate.

[[Vurahi]] has significantly above-average economic performance amongst its Areoix Lie metropolitan peers, and numerous companies have moved employees and their headquarters to the city in recent years. In 1765, according to Statistics [[Areoix Lie]] ([[Stats AL]]), Vurahi had the second lowest unemployment rate out of all Areoix Lie cities.

=== Economic growth ===
In 1753, [[Vurahi]] was considered the most [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Entrepreneurship entrepreneurial] city in [[Areoix Lie]], with the percentage of Vury pursuing business opportunities almost three times higher than the national average. Vury aged between 18 and 64 were 120% more likely to pursue new business, whilst in [[Zirohu]], the same demographic group was 190% more likely than the national average to pursue a new business.

With the second highest number of successful information technology companies in  [[Acrohea]], Vurahi is an important centre for the industry on the continent. This includes an increasing number of companies in the space industry. Vurahi is home to over 60 fintech startups.

Growing at an annual rate of 8.5% and an estimated worth of ₳1.77 trillion in 1753, nationwide the high tech industry in Vurahi is becoming increasingly important to the city's economy. A number of entrepreneurial initiatives and universities hosting technology startups such as Admyt, Xneelo, Jumo, Yoco, Aerobotics, Luno, Rain, and The Sun Exchange are located in the city.

The city has the second largest film industry in the Eastern Hemisphere generating {{lahn}}782 million in revenue and providing an estimated 26,058 direct and 6,502 indirect jobs in 1759. Much of the industry is based out of the Vurahi Land Film Studios.

[[Vurahi]] is also claims the largest [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Inland_port inland port] in the world ( The [[Port of Vurahi]]). The annual cargo of the port in 1764 was 42 million tons. this ranks it the 7th busiest [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Port port] in [[Areoix Lie]]

As of 1764, [[Vurahi|Vurahi's]] labor force consists of 13.1 million workers. The largest sector in [[Vurahi]] is the professional and business services industry, which accounts for 29.61% of the city's workforce.

Within this sector, the professional, scientific, and technical services industry accounts for 23.34% of the city's employment, which is the highest of any other industry.

The construction industry is the second-largest by number of employees, as it accounts for 9.29%  of the city's employment. The manufacturing sector, the second largest sector, also accounts for a large part of the city's employment opportunities as it provides 18.15% of the city's employment.

In recent years, Vurahi, has become a global conference hub, and a highly desirable place to host delegates for meetings. [[The Vurahi International Convention Centre (VICC)]] in Vurahi's CBD hosts many large conferences throughout each year. The city has been increasing in popularity in this regard, and in June 1765, it was reported that Vurahi had reached 15th place globally in the International Congress and Convention Association's (ICCA) rankings of popular destinations for international association meetings.

The report highlighted that [[Vurahi]] hosted 145 such meetings in 1764, which comprises 35% of the total hosted across Areoix Lie that year. [[Vurahi]] also placed among the top 10 cities worldwide for average attendance per event, with an average of 717 delegates per meeting.

Virauzau's official tourism, trade, and investment promotion agency, Viz-Gro, stated that Vurahi and [[Virauzau Convention Bureau]] secured 36 new conference bids in the 1764/1765 financial year alone. These events are expected to generate ₳1.132 billion in economic impact, and attract over 87,000 delegates through to 1768. 

=== '''Major companies''' ===
( TBH )

=== Inequality ===
[[The City of Vurahi|The city of Vurahi]]'s Gini coefficient of 0.36 is lower than Areoix Lie's Gini coefficient of 0.4. This makes it more equal than the rest of the country, including any other major  city, Areoix Lie's although still fairly unequal by international standards.

Between 1750 and 1755 the city's Gini coefficient, a measure of inequality, improved by dropping from 0.38 in 2007 to 0.36 

=== Tourism ===
[[Virauzau]] is a highly important tourist region in [[Areoix Lie]]; the tourism industry accounts for 9.8% of the GDP of the province and employs 9.6% of the province's workforce. In 1754, over 23 million international tourists visited the area. This is driven by The regions Cuisine, night life and Historical monuments.

[[Vurahi]] is not only a popular international tourist destination in Areoix Lie, but [[Acrohea]] as a whole. This is due to its mild climate, natural setting, inland geography, and well-developed infrastructure.

The city has several well-known natural features that attract tourists, most notably [[The seat of Vurahi]], which forms a large part of the [[The seat of Vurahi Mountain National Park]] and is the back end of the City. Reaching the top of the mountain can be achieved by either hiking up or the [[Seat of Vurahi Cable car|Cable Car]].

The [[Vera & Aperdies Waterfront ( V&A Waterfront)|Vera & Aperdies Waterfront]] is a mixed-use development built on top of part of the docks of the [[Port of Vurahi]], and is the city's most-visited tourist attraction. It is also one of the city's most popular shopping venues, with several hundred shops as well as the [[Imperial Aquarium of Vurahi|Imperial Aquarium]].

The cities largest and arguably best tourist attractions are the [[3rd Imperial Palace of Vurahi|Imperial Palace]], [[Imperial Fortress of Vurahi|The Imperial Fortress]] and the [[Vurahi Imperial Gardens|Imperial Gardens]]. These and many other remnants of the empire are the main reason [[Vurahi]] is such a tourist hub. 

The primary focus of Vurahi Tourism is to represent and advocate for [[Vurahi]] as an appealing tourist destination, as well as to track and report on metrics related to tourism in Vurahi (which VT does as part of its Annual Report, published online). Vurahi Tourism receives a portion of its funding from [[the City of Vurahi]] while the remainder is made up of membership fees and own-generated funds.

[[Tristan Fe Cunha]] owns and operates a lodging facility in Vurahi which charges discounted rates to [[Tristan Fa Cunha|Tristan Fa Cunha club members]]. Vurahi transport system links it to the rest of [[Areoix Lie]]; it serves as the gateway to other destinations within the province. [[The Virauzau Winelands]] and in particular the towns of [[Helio]], [[Vaarl]] and [[Emerprat]] are popular day trips from the city for sightseeing and wine tasting.

== Housing ==
Vurahi has a mix of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Detached_homes detached homes] of various sizes, [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Townhouses townhouses], and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Apartments apartments]. Certain [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neighborhoods neighborhoods] (especially older ones and those in the [[Western Suburbs of Vurahi|Western Suburbs]]) tend to be dominated by larger, detached houses on separate plots of land, with parks and tree-lined streets. Newer suburbs, and those in the [[Eastern Suburbs]], feature more of a mix of housing types, including low- and high-rise buildings and townhouse developments.

=== Home ownership ===
The city has for years had the second most expensive average home price in [[Areoix Lie]]. In September 1764, the average property price in Vurahi was ₳1.172 million. This was an increase of 36% from the average price of ₳854,321 in 1754 (a decade before), indicating consistently strong returns on [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Investment investment] for those in the Vurahi property market. Sellers often get their asking price, or within 5% of it.

== Culture ==
Main article: [[Culture in Vurahi]]

=== Architecture ===
This section is an excerpt from [[Architecture of Vurahi.]]

The architecture of Vurahi over the centuries has greatly developed from [[Kingdom of Areoix Lie|The kingdom of Areoix Lie]] architecture to [[Arten modern and contemporary architecture]]. [[Vurahi]] was once one of the world's main epicentres of [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Classical_architecture Classical architecture], developing new forms such as the dome and the vault. [[The Imperial style of Architecture|The Imperial style]] in the 11th, 12th and 13th centuries was also widely used in [[Architecture of Vurahi|Vury architecture]], and later the city became one of the main centres of Renaissance and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Baroque_architecture Baroque] architecture. Vurahis cityscape is also widely [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Neoclassical_architecture Neoclassical] and Imperial in style.

The city also encloses the 36 hectare [[Imperial Gardens of Vurahi|The Imperial Gardens]] that contains protected natural forest and fynbos along with a variety of animals and birds. There are over 7,000 species in cultivation at [[Imperial Gardens of Vurahi|The Imperial Gardens]], including many rare and threatened species of the [[Virauzau Floristic Region]]. In 1742 this Region, including [[Imperial Gardens of Vurahi|The Imperial Gardens]], was declared a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

==== Statues ====
[[Vurahi]] is well known for its statues but, in particular, [[the talking statues of Vurahi]]. These are usually ancient statues which have become popular soapboxes for political and social discussion, and places for people to (often satirically) voice their opinions. There are two main talking statues: the [[Marquino]] and the [[Parforio]], yet there are four other noted ones. Most of these statues are ancient Imperial or classical, and most of them also depict mythical gods, ancient people or legendary figures. [[Orin Valorion|Orin Valorum]] is the only non-Imperial statue, created in 1720. They are often, due to their status, covered with placards or graffiti expressing political ideas and points of view. Other statues in the city, which are not related to the talking statues, include those of [[the Isle of the Emperors]], or several monuments scattered across the city, such as that to [[Veravon the 3rd|Veravon]] in the Kappa Fe-Fiori.

==== Catacombs ====
Main article: [[Catacombs of Vurahi]]

[[Vurahi]] has an extensive amount of ancient catacombs, or underground burial places under or near the city, of which there are at least forty, some discovered only in recent decades. Though most famous for _______burials, they include pagan and _______burials, either in separate catacombs or mixed together. The first large-scale catacombs were excavated from the 2nd century onwards. Originally they were carved through [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Tuff tuff], a soft [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Volcanic_rock volcanic rock], outside the boundaries of the city, because Imperial law forbade burial places within city limits. Currently, maintenance of the catacombs is in the hands of the _______ which has invested in the ______ the supervision of the Catacombs of St. Callixtus on the outskirts of Vurahi.

=== Cuisine ===
See also: [[Arten cuisine]]

[[Vurahi|Vurahis's]] cuisine has evolved through centuries and periods of social, cultural, and political changes. Vurahi became a major gastronomical centre during the ancient age. Ancient Vury cuisine was highly influenced by nearby tribes, and after, the empire's enormous expansion exposed Vurys to many new, provincial culinary habits and cooking techniques.

Food originating from or synonymous with Vurahi includes the savoury sweet spiced meat dish [[Vobotie]] that dates from the 13th century. The [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gatsby_(sandwich) Gatsby], a sandwich filled with slap chips and other toppings, was first served in 1717 in the suburb of [[Nor Handa]] and is also synonymous with the city. The [[Cho'sister]] is a traditional Arten pastry described as a cinnamon infused dumpling with a cake-like texture, finished off with a sprinkling of desiccated coconut.

[[The Porvuka]], Vurahi's trade and slaughterhouse area, was often known as the "belly" or "slaughterhouse" of Vurahi, and was inhabited by butchers, or ''Porvuks''. The old-fashioned [[Perkant]]  (oxtail cooked in the way of butchers) is still one of the city's most popular meals and is part of most of Vurahis's restaurants' menus. Lamb is also a very popular part of Vury cuisine, and is often roasted with spices and herbs.

[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Malva_pudding Malva pudding] (sometimes known as Arten Malva pudding) is a sticky sweet dessert often served with hot custard is also associated with the city and dates back to the 12th century. A related dessert dish, [[Vury Brandy Pudding]], is also associated with the city and surrounding region. Vurahi is also the home of the [[Arten wine]] industry with the first wine produced in the country being bottled in the city; a number of notable wineries still exist in the city including [[Nor Havan]] and [[Chur Havan]].

=== Media ===
Main articles: [[Media of Vurahi|Music in Vurahi and Events in Vurahi]]

[[Vurahi]] is an important centre for music, and it has an intense musical scene, including several prestigious music conservatories and theatres. It hosts the [[Accademia Republican Fa kecilian]] (founded in 1426), for which new concert halls have been built in the [[Nor Vama Musil]], one of the largest musical venues in the world. Vurahi also has an opera house, the [[Trevo Fel'Opera fa Vurahi]], as well as several minor musical institutions. 

Several newspapers, magazines and printing facilities have their offices in the city. Independent News and Media publishers the major Arten language papers in the city, the ''Vury Argus'' and the ''Vury Times''. [[Hag-Verenz]], the largest media conglomerate in [[Areoix Lie]] publishes ''Fa Vurger'', the most read paper in the country. [[Vurahi]] was formally also home to [[The Areox Lie News Agency (ALN)|ALN]] however since 1736 [[The Areox Lie News Agency (ALN)|ALN]] relocated to [[Zirohu]].  

[[Vurahi]] is a centre for major broadcast media with several radio stations that only broadcast within the city. [[94.5 Vfm]] (94.5 MHz FM) and Good Hope FM (94–97 MHz FM) mostly play [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Pop_music pop music]. Heart FM (104.9 MHz FM), the former P4 Radio, plays [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Jazz jazz] and [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Contemporary_R%26B R&B], while Fine Music Radio (101.3 FM) plays [https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/European_classical_music classical music] and jazz, and Magic Music Radio (828 kHz MW) plays adult contemporary and classic rock from the '80s, '90s and '00s 

Bush Radio is a community radio station (89.5 MHz FM). [[The Voice of Vurahin]] (95.8 MHz FM) and [[Virauzau Talk]] (567 kHz MW) are the major talk radio stations in the city. . [[The University of Vurahi]] also runs its own radio station, UV Radio (104.5 MHz FM). 

Numerous productions companies and their support industries are located in the city, mostly supporting the production of overseas commercials, model shoots, TV-series and movies. The local media infrastructure remains primarily in [[Zirohu]].
